# Databases on AWS

Skills that teach agents to work with Databases on AWS. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [awslabs/agent-plugins](https://github.com/awslabs/agent-plugins), at commit `fbefb37`.

Expert database guidance for the AWS database portfolio.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Databases on AWS**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Databases on AWS**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install databases-on-aws@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `dsql`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

1 script file ship inside the skills. The agent can run it on your machine. Read it first.

The `dsql` skill links to the vendor's plugin-level `scripts/` folder and `.mcp.json`, which are not part of this plugin, so those links and the helper scripts they point to are missing. The skill files are unchanged.
